title: Prepare Cash Flow Dashboard Print Saved View Eligibility Contract

eligibility_decision.reason: The target is a standalone print rendering surface. It should inherit/filter context from the parent cash-flow dashboard URL rather than own saved view controls.
eligibility_decision.recommended_next_phase: Exclude print-only report views from the rollout selector before selecting the next interactive target.

proposed_exclusion.exclusion_rule: ReportSavedViewRolloutSelector should ignore report candidates whose key ends with -print or whose view_path ends with -print.blade.php.
proposed_exclusion.expected_result_after_exclusion: cash-flow-dashboard-print should no longer be the next rollout target.

guardrails: Do not add saved view controls to standalone print documents.
Do not register print-only views in ReportSavedViewRegistry.
Do not add saved view store routes for print-only views.
Do not modify shared saved view partials.
Implement exclusion in selector/prioritization before locking the next target.
